prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Instagram cover image, vertical 4:5
Primary request: Photorealistic Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing at night under bright stadium floodlights, with distant city lights softly blurred and calm dark water.
Scene/backdrop: Night racecourse; distant city lights only, no readable signage or markings.
Subject: One authentic Japanese kyotei racing boat banking into a tight left turn around one orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy. The boat is a single-seat racing boat about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer, with a light white or pale-grey hull. It must not resemble an offshore powerboat or F1 tunnel boat. Open cockpit only: no canopy, roof, or windshield bubble. The racer crouches or kneels low in the open cockpit, leans forward, and holds a small steering wheel with both hands. Racer wears a plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face is not visible. One outboard motor is mounted on the stern, throwing a large white spray plume that curves outward behind the turn.
Style/medium: Highly realistic sports photography with credible boat proportions, water physics, and stadium illumination.
Composition/framing: Portrait 4:5. Keep the boat and buoy entirely in the lower half. The top 45% must remain dark, uncluttered negative space suitable for later title overlay.
Lighting/mood: Dramatic night race lighting, bright floodlights reflecting subtly on dark water, energetic but clean.
Text: none.
Constraints: Exactly one racing boat; authentic open-cockpit kyotei form; orange-and-white cylindrical buoy; no recognizable real person.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, boat numbers, branding, flags, banners, emblems, or typographic-like marks anywhere. No canopy, no roof, no windshield bubble.
verification: Visually inspected the generated image. It shows one low, light-colored, open-cockpit kyotei racing boat with a crouched helmeted racer, one stern outboard motor, a large curved spray plume, and an orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy at a floodlit night racecourse. The upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, or flags were observed.
